statement: Every cycle C_N, N≥3, admits N·binom(N−1,floor((N−1)/2)) distinct real phase equilibria modulo common phase, attaining its complex bound. The construction uses zero frequencies, all couplings +1 when 4 does not divide N, and one coupling −1 with all others +1 when 4 divides N; the latter case uses signed real couplings.

source.location: Section IV.A, Theorem 1 and proof, printed p.7; Section II.A for lossless, fixed-voltage identification

scope: Finite isolated-equilibrium maximum on the cycle subclass, with arbitrary nonzero real symmetric couplings allowed.
notes: The construction has zero frequencies. If 4 does not divide N, all edge couplings are 1; if 4 divides N, one edge is −1 and the others are 1. Thus the latter case does not prove attainment with all couplings positive.
